title: Breadcrumb
desc: A search engine for your own memory. Save anything in one tap, find it later by describing it.
longDesc: 1st place at Hackinverse 1.0. We save things everywhere and find them nowhere: screenshots, links, PDFs and recommendations scatter across a dozen apps, and later you remember what you saved but not where you put it. Breadcrumb is two flows and nothing else. Saving is frictionless, one tap from the share sheet, a Quick Settings tile or your voice, with no folders, tags or titles to fill in. Retrieval is the product: a single search bar where you type what you remember, like "that internship screenshot from April", and it finds the thing even when those words appear nowhere in it. EmbeddingGemma 2 runs on the phone and scores meaning alongside the phone's own keyword search, so nothing you save or type ever leaves the device. There is no server and no account, and search works in airplane mode.

title: Cosmic Game Sanctuary
desc: An indie game store where revenue splits pay a whole team at once, trials are billed by the minute, and an agent can buy for you.
longDesc: Built for ETHOnline 2026, and nothing in it is a mock. Cosmic Game Sanctuary is a storefront for browser games settled on Hedera. Browse without logging in, sign in with just an email, buy, and the game boots in the same tab a few seconds later, its build pinned to IPFS and unpacked live in the browser. You can play by the minute first, metered from your own wallet over x402, and every cent spent trying comes off the price. Developers drop a zip, watch it run before publishing, and split revenue with a team by email: a teammate who has never touched a wallet still gets paid the moment they accept, and the split locks at publish. Give the agent a want and a ceiling and it watches a public Hedera topic, buying at the last responsible moment before a sale ends. Buyers sign their own purchases so the server never holds anyone's key, and uploaded games run on a separate origin so a stranger's build can never read your session.

title: Skrim
desc: A browser agent that does the task without your personal data ever leaving your machine.
longDesc: Built for HackSpire. AI browser agents work by sending your screen to someone else's server, so your inbox, your bank balance and your face end up on a stranger's GPU. Skrim keeps all of that on your device. A local pipeline reads the page, runs OCR on canvases and images, and finds private data with regexes, form-field hints and an on-device GLiNER model, then swaps every value for a placeholder like <PII:EMAIL:1> before anything is sent. The planning model only ever sees the scrubbed page, and the extension puts the real value back only at the moment it types it. The guardrails run on the device, so no prompt can switch them off: a value only goes where you meant it to, ID and card numbers are always checked with you first, and unasked purchases or deletions are refused. Detection hits 99% recall across 37 test pages, and it runs in Chrome, in Firefox, and in Firefox on Android.

title: NextWeeb
desc: Your personalized anime discovery and tracking web app.
longDesc: NextWeeb is your ultimate companion for discovering and tracking anime. With intelligent recommendations based on your watch history, season tracking, and a beautiful interface, you'll never miss your next favorite series.

title: Supernote
desc: Turns raw startup ideas into structured and validated projects using AI and interactive graphs.
longDesc: Supernote leverages AI to transform rough startup concepts into comprehensive business plans. Interactive mind maps and validation frameworks help entrepreneurs visualize and refine their ideas before investing time and resources.

title: Synapse
desc: A focused learning app using flashcards and proven memory techniques for busy students.
longDesc: Synapse is a comprehensive learning platform designed to help busy students master complex subjects through spaced repetition and active recall. The app features customizable flashcard decks, progress tracking, and adaptive learning algorithms.

title: Calcutta Collective
desc: A location-first PWA that turns city discovery into small, real-world hangouts.
longDesc: Cities are full of people, and yet urban loneliness keeps rising — everyone saves cafés they never visit. The problem isn't a lack of information, it's a lack of activation, so Calcutta Collective is built around closing that gap. Discovery is map-driven rather than list-driven, hangouts cap at 5–8 people so they feel intimate rather than like an event, and hosts approve join requests so a group chat can break the ice before anyone shows up. Afterwards, reflections feed back into the discovery loop. Built solo as a competition product and pitched at BPlan @ Kshitij 2025 (IIT Kharagpur) and the Hult Prize 2025 campus round.

title: ResQNet
desc: A unified platform for rapid, coordinated emergency response.
longDesc: ResQNet revolutionizes emergency response coordination by providing a centralized platform for first responders, emergency services, and civilians. Real-time updates, location tracking, and instant communication help save lives when every second counts.

title: AURA
desc: An AI-powered healthcare assistant with medical image analysis, smart health records, and nearby hospital/doctor discovery.
longDesc: AURA is a patient-centric healthcare assistant that combines AI diagnostics, a digital health record vault, and real-time hospital/doctor discovery. Users can upload medical data, analyze scans for fractures or brain tumors using ML models, identify medications through image input, and interact with an AI chatbot that explains medical information in simple language.

title: EchoWall
desc: Aggregates content from all your social media platforms into one unified, interactive feed.
longDesc: EchoWall creates a unified social media experience by aggregating posts, photos, and updates from all your platforms into a single, customizable feed. Save time and stay connected without the constant app-switching.
